arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to the pgbouncer connection pool refresh. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, with 47 malformed rows blocking the retry queue. These rows were deleted to unblock the queue immediately. An export of the failed_jobs table was also provided for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the failed_jobs to understand the root cause of the malformed rows and implement a solution to prevent future failures.
